name: Lucian
notes: Lucian opens with The Culling (R) immediately since its ~90-110s cooldown means only one cast ever fits in a fight of this length; the 3s channel disables Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze and stops basic attacks (Relentless Pursuit stays usable).

Casting Q, W, E or R arms Lightslinger: the next basic attack that lands within 3.5s fires a second shot 0.25s later for bonus physical damage scaled by level and total AD; that second shot can critically strike on its own.
Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze are each cast the instant they come off cooldown (once the R channel ends), dealing their flat damage on cast and taking the engine's standard 0.25s cast lockout.

Relentless Pursuit is cast on cooldown purely for its attack-timer reset and to arm Lightslinger; every Lightslinger second shot lands on the dummy (which counts as an enemy champion), refunding 2s off Relentless Pursuit's remaining cooldown each time.

The Culling's total bullet count is computed once from the build's crit chance and crit damage using the sheet's own formula (22 * (1 + critChance * (critDamage - 1))), floored to a whole number of bullets, and dealt as a single damage instance when the 3s channel ends; individual bullets do not separately roll a crit since the crit chance is already folded into the bullet count.

Piercing Light's cast time is recorded from the numbers-sheet's flat 0.35s figure rather than the wiki's per-rank 0.4-0.25s array; the engine only needs to know an ability has a cast time (a fixed 0.25s attack lockout), so this choice does not change the result.

Vigilance (bonus magic damage on Lucian's next two shots after being healed or shielded by an ally, or after an enemy is immobilized) never triggers in an allyless, CC-ignored dummy fight, so it is omitted.
Lightslinger's bonus damage against minions (100% AD) is irrelevant since the fight has no minions.
Mana is not modeled: at level 16 the combined Q/W/E/R costs are well within a champion's mana pool for a fight of this length.
